label: A2B9CD11E2_mP100_14_2e_9e_e_11e_2e-001
title: (AlPO$_{4}$)$_{2}$(OH)(H$_{2}$O)$_{2}$$\cdot$NH$_{4}$ [AlPO$_{4}$-15 Framework] Structure
comments:
Like \href{current_web_home_dir/A3B4CDE13F3_mP100_14_3e_4e_e_e_13e_3e-001}{AlPO$_{4}$-15} and \href{current_web_home_dir/A9B55C9_hP146_176_hi_a2h8i_hi-001}{AlPO$_{4}$-17}, this is an \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{AlPO$_{4}$ framework} with embedded ammonium and hydroxide ions and water molecules. Like \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C6D_oP96_61_c_4c_6c_c-001}{varisite}, some of the AlO$_{4}$ tetrahedra are replaced by AlO$_{5}$(H$_{2}$O) octahedra. 
 We use the ``D'' data from (Byrne, 2009), which was given in the $P2_{1}/n$ orientation of space group \#14. We used AFLOW to transform this to the standard $P2_{1}/c$ orientation, which resulted in a change of lattice vectors.
